page.overview:
What is Pocha Pocha no Mi?

The Pocha Pocha no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to add excess fat on an opponent's body, making the user a . It was eaten by Neiro.

This fruit allows the user to control their own body fat and the body fat of their opponents. Its main strength lies in its ability to immobilize opponents and reduce their athletic ability by turning them obese. It even works on opponents who do not have flesh, like Brook. When the user reduces their own body fat, they can also harden and fortify their body, improving their defenses.

The main weakness is that the fat created by the fruit's abilities can be burned off easily with a high metabolism and rigorous physical activity. Otherwise, the standard Devil Fruit weakness apply.

Neiro uses his abilities to immobilize opponents and strengthen himself.
